data.long_meaning: The name Balbinder is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bal' meaning strength and 'bindu' meaning drop or mark. The name Balbinder carries the meaning “Brave Binder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Balbinder usually hope their child will grow to embody brave binder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
